hypotheses: A nonempty visible prefix Fin(n+1). Weights sum to one for zero-row-sum, constant-signal cancellation and anchor invariance. Prefix congruence uses fixed causal weights and values agreeing at all positions <= n.
proven: Causal mixing has zero row sum; equals the weighted average minus uniform prefix mean; annihilates constant values; permits evaluation on differences from a common anchor; consumes no value beyond the query prefix.
nonvacuity: Concrete normalized nonuniform weights, nonzero value vectors, different unseen suffixes and a nonzero mixing result on unequal values.
limits: Real arithmetic identities only. The weights themselves must be computed causally. The linear-stage anchor invariance does not imply translation invariance of the complete Q/K- and own-value-dependent attention function. No causal spectral-gap, finite-precision, optimizer convergence or grokking theorem is asserted.
inherited_bounds: The PeriBounds fixture applies unchanged because every new raw branch still passes through output RMS and 1/sqrt(2L) scaling.
